tagline: Shall we get those muscles moving?
synopsis: Set in a magical world where magic determines one's worth, Mashle follows Mash Burnedead, a boy born completely incapable of using magic but gifted with extraordinary physical strength through daily training. To protect the father who raised him, Mash sets out to become a Divine Visionary, the most powerful mage in the world.
